feedback.issue: Post-edit validation hook execution claimed but no backup files found in .backups/docker-specialist-* directory. Claim cannot be verified.

feedback.issue: provider-auth-tests.sh line 60: docker exec command in variable assignment lacks explicit error handling. With set -euo pipefail, failure is silent and causes $actual_value to be empty, potentially masking test failures.
feedback.suggestion: Add error handling: actual_value=$(docker exec "$TEST_AGENT" sh -c "echo \$$var_name") || { log_error "docker exec failed"; return 1; }

feedback.issue: 11 new untracked files created (agent-lifecycle-tests.sh, clustering-accuracy-tests.sh, etc.). Unclear if these are part of iteration plan or unintended drift. File count increased from 7 claimed to 18 total.
feedback.suggestion: Clarify intent for each untracked file: (1) Required dependencies → stage immediately, (2) WIP future tests → move to .backups or add to .gitignore, (3) Examples/templates → document purpose or delete.
